heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 119–60, div. C, title XXXI, § 3111(b)(1), Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1458

notes.text: Section 2661, Pub. L. 107–314, div. D, title XLV, § 4510, as added Pub. L. 114–328, div. C, title XXXI, § 3112(a), Dec. 23, 2016, 130 Stat. 2756, authorized actions to protect certain nuclear facilities and assets from unmanned aircraft. See section 6227 of Title 10, Armed Forces.

Section 2662, Pub. L. 107–314, div. D, title XLV, § 4511, as added Pub. L. 116–283, div. C, title XXXI, § 3131(a), Jan. 1, 2021, 134 Stat. 4383, required establishment of procedures for reporting penetrations of certain networks of contractors and subcontractors. See section 6228 of Title 10, Armed Forces.
